jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Brand Protection
jobs.description:
Protecting and building a future shaped by original ideas, innovations, and creativity.

From counterfeits and pirated content to fraudulent sites and unauthorized sellers, MarqVision provides an end-to-end brand integrity platform across e-commerce, social media and emerging AI platforms. Our AI-powered managed service platform for brand control and intelligence enables rapid, scalable enforcement so that brands can move faster, protect revenue, and preserve brand equity across every digital touchpoint. In a time when IP infringements pose an increasingly serious challenge, we believe that democratizing legal expertise and access to the latest in generative AI technology is critical for continuing to support the inventors, developers, and artists of the world who work tirelessly to deliver safe, high-quality products. Founded by Harvard Law graduates in 2020, MarqVision recently raised Series B, bringing total funding to $89M, and is backed by Y Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), HSG (formerly Sequoia Capital China), Salesforce Ventures, Altos Ventures, DST Global Partners, and Softbank. Recognized with an LVMH Innovation Award and the Inc 5000 Fastest Growing Companies award in 2025, MarqVision continues to push boundaries in brand control, ensuring that innovation, creativity, and trust remain safeguarded in a rapidly evolving digital world.

How You'll Make an Impact at MarqVision

At MarqVision, we’re redefining brand protection with cutting-edge AI and automation solutions. As a Senior Product Manager, Brand Protection, you’ll take the lead in building mission-critical tools that detect, analyze, and combat IP infringement across global online platforms. You’ll work closely with engineering, business, and go-to-market teams to develop scalable, AI-powered solutions that eliminate threats at scale. If you’re passionate about leveraging AI to solve real-world challenges and shaping the future of brand protection technology, we want to hear from you!

What You’ll Achieve

- Develop and scale brand protection solutions that enable rapid and effective enforcement against counterfeits and infringements.

- Work closely with top-tier engineering and AI teams to define, develop, and maintain a feature roadmap and backlog aligned with strategic business objectives.

- Establish and drive OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) for brand protection products, consistently tracking and optimizing performance metrics.

- Proactively engage with business and operations teams to identify market challenges and translate complex brand protection requirements into practical product solutions.

- Partner with senior leadership to align brand protection product initiatives with overall company strategy, ensuring impactful and efficient product enhancements.

- Work cross-functionally with peer Product Managers, Sales, Customer Success, and Operations, to streamline implementation and manage interdependencies.

Skills You Bring

- 5+ years of experience in technical product management, with a proven track record of developing and scaling successful B2B, B2C, or internal-facing products.

- Bilingual proficiency in English and Korean, with the ability to navigate global markets, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and engage international customers.

- Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and persuasively, both verbally and in writing.

- Action-oriented mindset, thriving in fast-paced, ambiguous environments while driving execution with a bias for action.

- Analytical and data-driven problem-solving skills, leveraging both qualitative and quantitative data to tackle complex and ambiguous challenges.

Nice to Have

- Experience in global B2B SaaS product development, successfully launching and expanding B2B products in international markets.

- Background in AI-driven solutions, with hands-on experience in machine learning applications or AI-powered products.

- Proficiency in SQL (intermediate to advanced level) or a strong ability to rapidly upskill in data analysis and querying.

Additional Reference

- MarqVision Company Blog

- Leadership Team

Be Part of the MarqVision Team

- Collaborate with a global team spanning 10+ countries and make a worldwide impact.

- Enjoy flexible working hours (8–10 AM start) and a hybrid work model (2 remote days per week).

- Receive U.S. stock-based compensation upon joining.

- Stay healthy with company-sponsored regular health checkups.

- Improve your skills with in-office English conversation classes.

- Get lunch allowances when working in the office and dinner & taxi fare support for late workdays.

- Bond with your team through company-sponsored lunches and dinners.

- Enjoy a fully stocked office with snacks, beverages, coffee, and even beer!

Interview Process

- Please submit all documents as a PDF file

- The interview process is as follows

- Application Review > Screening Interview > Hiring Manager Interview > Team Interview  > Culture Fit Interview > Case Study  > Final Interview

- The interview process is subject to change.

- This is a full-time position with a 6-month probationary (trial) period

- Please ensure that all submitted documents are accurate. Any false information may result in the withdrawal of your acceptance or offer of employment.

Equal Opportunity

At MarqVision, we believe real growth comes with attracting the brightest minds, motivating them to succeed in their position, and ensuring plenty of fun along the way. If you think this position is for you, apply now! MarqVision is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages applicants of all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

By applying for this role, you acknowledge MarqVision’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. Please review our  Candidate Privacy Notice .
